findings.identity: Neet: projecting modest muzzle, broad upright ears, fine legs, full narrow fawn torso, tiny nub. Buddy: pale brows and moustache, pendant furnished ears, dark eye surrounds and charcoal torso with regional pale fields.
findings.anatomy_support_proportions: Neet has four separately owned grounded paws and continuous neck/back/pelvis, with natural clearance. Buddy seated construction connects head through neck/chest to supported rump; two forepaws and folded hind feet belong clearly to his body. No duplicated or disconnected limb. Seated frontal perspective foreshortens trunk.
findings.coat: Smooth torso color planes with no engraved curls or raised shag. Buddy ear/muzzle/paw-tip strands are valid regional furnishings; tail has limited terminal fringe. Neet clean body contour and short nub remain readable.
findings.spatial_relations: Chirag is supported on raised rock. Roots and ground establish depth; foreground dogs and two background spectators are separate silhouettes without merged limbs.
findings.scene_state: Seated rueful Buddy and expectant standing Neet fit the Quiet-category reaction before Volume. Judge is elevated; no later competition result appears. Spectators are selective framing of gathering.
findings.historical_setting_comedy_finish: Banyan aerial roots, plain masonry and moonlight preserve village-night setting. Proud Neet versus disappointed Buddy carries the quiet joke. Clean finish and no unwanted lettering.

findings.identity: Neet preserves broad ears, cream muzzle/throat, narrow complete body, fine legs and tiny nub. Buddy preserves projecting furnished muzzle, pendant ears, pale brows/distal legs, moderately elongated charcoal trunk and substantial legs.
findings.anatomy_support_proportions: Four visible separately connected paws per foreground dog. Buddy forelegs emerge from chest and hindlegs from pelvis; both dogs have contact shadows and belly clearance. Buddy larger foreground scale reads with perspective, not detached or shortened anatomy.
findings.coat: Smooth Neet torso; slight neck edge transitions do not create long fur. Buddy charcoal body is broad clean color planes without engraved strands. Ear, muzzle and distal furnishings remain regional. Modest tail fringe does not become plume. Plaster texture is not dog fur.
findings.spatial_relations: Clear space separates facing foreground dogs; two spectators are separately grounded at lane end. Converging masonry and floor shadows establish depth.
findings.scene_state: Neet closed mouth follows his yip. Buddy open mouth and forward body match Six announcement before his voice returns and he closes mouth.
findings.historical_setting_comedy_finish: Plain plaster lane, windows, warm lamps and moonlight preserve intended setting. Buddy becoming loud contributes a distinct reversal after his quiet wish. No unwanted text, sound symbols or background landmark.

findings.identity: Neet retains broad triangular ears, projecting raised muzzle, cream throat/bib, fine legs and nub. Buddy retains pale brows/moustache, hanging ears, dark trunk, light distal legs and tapering dark tail.
findings.anatomy_support_proportions: Raised Neet jaw and extended neck connect continuously to chest/full narrow torso; four separate planted paws. Buddy head turn connects through neck/chest to continuous foreshortened trunk; four owned paws and real clearance. No disconnected anatomy.
findings.coat: Neet neck/trunk/legs use smooth shaded planes; Buddy dark torso has no engraved curls or raised shag. Furnished face/ears stay regional. Minor edge wisps do not enlarge trunk volume; mottled paving is surface texture.
findings.spatial_relations: Cropped walking human at left is separate from Neet; dogs remain grounded alongside departing figure. Buddy sidelong gaze contrasts with Neet upward howl.
findings.scene_state: Final victory howl while leaving and before treat invitation: Neet open mouth upward, Buddy closed mouth looking away, human departing. No treat appears ahead of narrative state.
findings.historical_setting_comedy_finish: Plain residential masonry, warm window and moon retain nighttime neighborhood. Human appearance remains provisional. Conspicuous howl versus Buddy attempted disassociation carries final visual joke. Clean finish, no lettering.
